scope: Single current-production DEV run; manual agent review; analysis only, not an independent human panel or a held-out benchmark claim.

embedding.query_prefix: Represent this sentence for searching relevant passages:

configuration.default_config_verification: Resolved settings matched defaults with application environment aliases removed; no model/retrieval/prompt overrides. Only persistence paths replaced by the evaluation CLI.
configuration.generation_cache: Quality runner does not cache generation; fresh workspace, repeat=1.

manual_review.method: Read every exact rendered context block, final output, and all 13 saved first-pass/repair pairs. Select bounded exact excerpts for this report; no full documents or raw candidate lists copied.
manual_review.primary_bucket_policy: Exactly one bucket for each suspicious row: substantive false abstention C first; lexical evaluator mismatch K next; otherwise repaired missing-citation defect I. Null means no observed defect. The qb2-026 resolver anomaly is recorded separately, not asserted to cause the abstention or double-counted as H.
manual_review.first_pass_trace_limit: The raw report stores parsed first-pass answer/status only when repair ran; it does not retain the original first-pass raw JSON envelope. No parser/format defect is evidenced by the saved missing-citations statuses and marker-free answer strings.

prompt_audit.observed_contract: Read all blocks; must answer if any block contains the requested fact; different phrasing is sufficient; use conservative restatement; abstain only if no block supports the answer; source-stated negatives allowed; report disagreements and cite each side; cite factual claims; return strict JSON.
prompt_audit.diagnosis: All three false abstentions have full direct gold evidence. Two have unchanged standalone questions, and one has a malformed follow-up rewrite. Negative/qualified/methodological sufficiency is a plausible weakness, not a demonstrated internal cause. Correct negative answers on qb2-025 and qb2-076 show the weakness is not universal.
prompt_audit.repair_contract: Reformat that answer as JSON using ONLY the same facts. Do not add claims.
prompt_audit.repair_observation: 11 marker-only and two grammar paraphrases; all 13 preserve substantive facts. Existing repair fixes citation compliance, not factual correctness, in this sample.
prompt_audit.generation_input: The resolved retrieval query is also the generation question; history is used by the resolver but not passed to build_request.
limitations: No prompt variants or counterfactual runs
No original raw first-pass JSON for repaired rows
One follow-up and one multi-source item
Citation validity and gold coverage do not certify semantic entailment

candidate_hypotheses.hypothesis: Direct negative, qualified or methodological statements may not consistently be recognized as sufficient answers to the requested property. Two non-follow-up refusals isolate the symptom from the resolver; the follow-up remains confounded.
Combining two explicit negative boundaries may increase refusal. Only one multi-source item exists and it fully abstained, so independent partial-answer behavior is unmeasured.
No DEV item requires conflict reporting. Incidental conflict text in other questions cannot validate both-side reporting or authority selection.
Citation formatting is a frequent first-pass compliance failure (13/24), but existing repair restores every case without changing facts; primarily a latency/call-count opportunity in this run.

candidate_hypotheses.decision: no observed substantive drift to target
candidate_hypotheses.hypothesis: The 13 observed repairs honor the same-facts contract; this small sample cannot establish universal safety.

Treating Describe as an entity and leaving the sampling-plan referent implicit may confuse generation. Gold retrieval still succeeds; no counterfactual establishes that correcting the rewrite would fix abstention.

recommended_first_experiment.scope: One prompt-only evidence-sufficiency clarification, evaluated on the fixed 24 DEV items in a future authorized task.
recommended_first_experiment.hypothesis: Make explicit that a source-stated negative, limitation, or qualified method is an answer when it directly addresses the requested property. Distinguish that from a requested quantity or property absent from the evidence. This may reduce supported refusals without encouraging guesses.
recommended_first_experiment.proposed_change: Clarify only the generation decision rule to recognize direct negative/qualified/method statements as sufficient, preserving their exact scope and citations. Use a general rule, not DEV identifiers, answers, entity names or question-specific exceptions. Keep the JSON schema, citation rules, conflict rules, and repair-specific instructions fixed.
